extracted.intended_audience: Rospatent staff, IP policymakers, patent attorneys, applicants and researchers using Russian patent/trademark statistics
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog of the quantitative indicators Rospatent uses in its 2019 annual report to measure activity and outcomes for trademarks, inventions (patents), and utility models — including counts of filings, examinations, decisions, regional and country breakdowns, IPC/CPC classifications, and year-on-year percent change columns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of applications filed
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of applications filed (presented separately for trademarks/service marks, inventions, utility models) in each year (2015–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show annual counts and include a column '2019 in % to 2018' giving year-on-year percent change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications by procedure: state vs international (Madrid/other)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of trademark/service mark applications 'following the state procedure' and number 'following the international procedure within the Madrid Agreement or Protocol'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported annually and used to separate national filings from Madrid-procedure filings; numbers sometimes broken down into further categories (e.g., legal protection granted under Madrid).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications by applicant nationality (Russian vs foreign)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications submitted 'by Russian applicants' and 'by foreign applicants' (for trademarks, inventions, utility models).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often reported side-by-side to show domestic vs foreign activity and used in subsequent breakdowns (e.g., decisions to grant by applicant nationality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of applications at the examination stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications that reached the examination stage during the year (for trademarks, inventions, utility models).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare workload and throughput; tables show how many of those proceed to decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of decisions taken following examination results
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of examination-stage decisions taken (e.g., grants, rejections) following substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears for trademarks and other IPR types as the summary of outcomes from examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions to grant legal protection / Decisions to issue a patent (grants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of decisions to grant legal protection for trademarks or to issue patents (inventions and utility models) in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often broken down into grants to Russian applicants and to foreign applicants; presented annually and compared across years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejections (by applicant nationality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications rejected, with counts sometimes split 'to Russian applicants' and 'to foreign applicants'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported annually and used together with grants and withdrawals to characterise examination outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions to withdraw the application (by applicant nationality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications withdrawn by applicants, with breakdowns for Russian and foreign applicants where provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes withdrawals at different stages (general withdrawal counts and those at formal examination).

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal and rejection at the stage of formal examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of withdrawals and rejections that occurred specifically at the formal examination stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A focused metric indicating attrition during formalities checks as opposed to substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-on-year percent change (2019 in % to 2018)
rubrics_metrics.description: For many indicators a '2019 in % to 2018' column is provided showing the percent change from 2018 to 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used throughout the tables to indicate trends; where present, both absolute counts and percent-change are shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of signs registered (trademarks/service marks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual total number of trademark and service mark signs registered in the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes breakdowns 'addressed to Russian applicants' and 'addressed to foreign applicants' and is reported for 2015–2019.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of extended signs (trademarks continued/extended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of trademarks whose protection period was extended (renewals/extension of marks) in the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where provided, the metric is split into those addressed to Russian applicants and to foreign applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of valid registrations at the end of the year
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock metric: total active/valid trademark registrations at year-end (excluding Madrid applications where noted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a point-in-time measure of the register's size; tables show year-end totals across years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of applications by Federal District (by applicant origin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of applications filed by Russian applicants by Federal District and constituent entities (counts by region).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables list detailed counts for each region and district; sometimes also give totals by district and percent shares.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative characteristics of filed applications by Federal District
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary comparative table showing number of requests by Federal District and percentage of total applications from Russian applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides regional share (% of total) to highlight concentration of filings across districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of registered trademarks by Federal District
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of registered trademarks broken down by Federal District and constituent entities for the reporting year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel to distribution of filings; used to assess regional registration outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative characteristics of issuance of certificates by Federal District
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percent shares of certificates issued (trademark certificates) by Federal District.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows regional issuance activity and percent-of-total for Russian applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications filed by foreign applicants: Top-15 countries (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications filed with Rospatent by foreign applicants from the 15 countries/organizations with the highest number of applications (for trademarks, inventions, utility models).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as rankings/ratings and used to show the composition of foreign filers; often includes separate tallies for trademarks and service marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ranking/Rating of countries by application volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank ordering (rating) of countries/organizations by total number of trademark or patent applications filed in the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables present the top countries and their ranks across years to show changes in rank positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration/Grant counts by foreign applicant country (registrations/patents issued)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of registrations (trademarks) or issued patents to foreign applicants from top countries (top-15 lists for registrations/grants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare filing volumes with successful registration/grant outcomes by country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of issued patents (inventions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual number of patents issued by Rospatent for inventions (total issued patents per year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often split into patents issued to Russian applicants and to foreign applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of valid patents as of December 31 (stock of valid patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock metric of patents that remain valid at year-end (total valid patents as of 31 Dec 2019, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculated from previous years’ stocks plus issued patents minus terminations/expired/non-payment decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: International searches on international applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of international searches performed on international patent applications (e.g., PCT searches) reported in the period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown under inventions metrics to reflect international cooperation/processing workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications transformed into application for another object of IPR protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of applications that were converted/transformed into applications for another type of IPR (e.g., from invention to utility model or vice versa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a separate line item indicating reclassification or conversion of filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issued patents: breakdown by applicant type (entities vs individuals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of issued patents separated by applicant category — legal entities vs individuals — for Russian and foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table provides trends over years showing shifts in entity vs individual patenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of applications by IPC Section (by applicant origin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications (inventions) broken down by IPC Section (A–H) and by applicant origin (Russian vs foreign).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to show technological composition of filings; tables present totals and per-section counts for the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamics of issued patents divided by IPC Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-to-year counts of issued patents categorized by IPC Section A–H for 2015–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows trends in technology areas over time; tables present both absolute counts and distributions for Russian vs foreign applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issued patents to foreign applicants: Top-15 countries
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of patents issued in 2019 to foreign applicants from the 15 countries with the highest number of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to show which countries receive the most patent grants in Russia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of valid patents of foreign applicants by country (year-end stock)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of valid patents held by foreign applicants from top countries as of December 31, 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A stock measure showing long-term presence of foreign patentees in Russia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of applications filed for utility models
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual count of utility model applications filed to Rospatent (2015–2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes breakdowns for Russian vs foreign applicants and percent change columns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility models: total number at examination stage / decisions (grants, rejections, withdrawals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for utility model applications at the examination stage and decisions made (grants, rejections, withdrawals), with breakdowns by applicant nationality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel structure to invention/patent tables, showing processing outcomes for utility models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total number of issued utility model patents and granted utility models
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts of utility model patents issued (granted) in the reporting year and breakdowns by Russian vs foreign applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables include year-on-year comparisons and summaries of granted utility models by CPC/IPC sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of valid utility model patents as of year-end
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock of valid utility model certificates/patents at year-end (e.g., valid as of December 31, 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Derived from previous stock, additions (grants) and terminations/expiry/non-payment in the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility models: distribution and comparative characteristics by Federal District
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percent shares of utility model applications and issued patents broken down by Federal District and constitutent entities, including entities vs individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables present district-level concentration metrics and percent-of-total figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility models: granted patents by Federal District (counts and % of whole)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility model patents granted in 2019 per Federal District with % share of the total grants by Russian applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to show geographic distribution of grants across districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing by foreign citizens for utility models: top countries and entity/individual split
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility model applications filed by foreign citizens from top countries, including separate counts for entities and individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps analyse the origin and type (entity/individual) of foreign utility model filers.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPC Section distribution of granted utility models (by year)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility model grants broken down by CPC Section (A–H) for each year 2015–2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows technological areas of utility model grants and trends over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications considered / decisions made on international utility model applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of international utility model applications considered and decisions made (grants, rejections, acceptances of withdrawals), including breakdowns by nationality and year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in the utility model dynamics tables; includes percent-to-previous-year comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional/top-region metrics (applications by top regions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications filed by Russian applicants from the top regions (e.g., Moscow, Moscow Region, Saint Petersburg, Republic of Tatarstan, etc.) with entity/individual splits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 1.16 and similar tables report top regional contributors and totals for comparative analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion/acceptance rates implied by counts (grants vs filings vs examination stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implicit performance metrics calculated from presented counts: e.g., proportion of filings reaching examination, proportion of examination-stage matters resulting in grants, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not explicitly labeled as a single table entry but can be computed from the provided counts (filings, examination-stage, decisions, grants, rejections, withdrawals).
